en: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!
Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!
You beat me again!
There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.
Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!
I don't believe it!
Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.
Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?
You're mean!
You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!
Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!
If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!
If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.
That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!
Be nice!
You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.
Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?
Lost!\nLost! Lost!
I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.
I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.
Done like dinner!
Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.
Eek!\nDid you touch me?
That's it?
ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.
ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD
